summary: Anthropic's AI for Science program grants free Claude API credits to researchers at research institutions working on high-impact scientific projects (biology/life sciences emphasized, other fields eligible). The Help Center (updated Mar 16, 2026) says successful applicants receive up to $20,000 in API credits for 6 months. Anthropic's Aug 27, 2026 news post says groups can apply for up to $50,000 in credits per project for more ambitious work. Credits are API-only (not Claude.ai). Applications are reviewed on the first Monday of each month. Distinct from the Claude Team plan for scientists seating promotion.
claim_steps: Create a Claude Console account if you do not already have one (API access; credits do not apply to Claude.ai).
Complete the AI for Science application form with team and project details (research-institution affiliation).
Wait for the monthly review (first Monday of each month). Unapproved submissions do not receive individual replies.
If approved, API credits are applied to the organization ID for the stated period. Multi-lab programs should apply on one account.

social_proof.title: Anthropic's AI for Science Program | Claude Help Center
social_proof.text: If successful, we will apply up to $20,000 in API credits to your account for a 6-month period. Note that these credits are for API use and do not apply to the Claude web app. We evaluate submissions on the first Monday of each month.

social_proof.title: Expanding our support for scientists
social_proof.text: As your lab makes use of your allotted credits and requires more usage than standard or premium plans provide, you can apply to our AI for Science program for up to $50,000 in credits per project. Any researcher is eligible to apply.
